demo.sectionBody: Captured directly from the running product. What you see here is what you use.

footer.tagline: Open legal workspace for work that matters.

hero.subtitle: One legal workspace for matters, documents, research, and agents.
hero.subtitle2: Grounded in sources, governed by your permissions, and built without lock-in.

home.ctaTitle: Your matters. Your stack. Your terms.

meta.homeDescription: Open source legal workspace for documents, matters, review, and research. Self-host or use our cloud. Usage-based AI, no lock-in.

story.agentBody: The agent searches the matter, reads the relevant text, and answers with citations that open the source at the exact passage. Use it in stella, Microsoft Teams, or through MCP and the CLI; the same permissions and sources follow the request.
story.agentTitle: Ask once. Every answer cites its source.
story.controlBody: stella is open-source legal software you can self-host: inspect the code, run it your way, and export everything in standard formats; no lock-in.
story.dataBody: Case law from official sources with its structure preserved, and company registries queried straight into the matter, jurisdiction by jurisdiction. Anonymization keeps identifying details out of AI workflows.
story.dataMainAlt: An official court decision open in stella
story.dataTitle: Bring the law and the data with you.
story.intro: A matter moves through the same connected system: from source material, through review and drafting, to a grounded answer or action.
story.proofByokBody: Use your own provider keys for AI features.
story.proofOpenSourceBody: Inspect the code and keep a portable system.
story.proofPermissionsBody: Requests remain scoped to the user and workspace.
story.proofSelfHostBody: Run stella on infrastructure you control.
story.title: One matter. Every part of the work.
story.workspaceBody: Documents, deadlines, structured review, and drafting stay together, searchable across every matter. Open a matter, see the work in context, and move from a table to the underlying document without rebuilding the trail.
story.workspaceTitle: Run the whole matter in one place.
